eyebrow.zh: 投毒输入 · 爆炸半径 · 一键复盘
eyebrow.en: Poisoned input · Blast radius · One-command review

headline.zh:
Agent 被 Prompt Injection 击穿后
秒级算出该隔离哪些动作
headline.en:
After your Agent gets prompt-injected,
see exactly which actions to roll back — in seconds

sub.zh: 给自主 Agent 的工具调用图装上动态污点追踪。一次投毒输入落地，沿调用图标记每一个被它影响的下游动作，列出需要隔离的操作与已证清白的操作。
sub.en: Dynamic taint tracking for your autonomous agent's tool-call graph. When a poisoned input lands, it labels every downstream action it influenced — and lists which to quarantine versus which are proven clean.

title.zh: 投毒落地的瞬间就标记它
title.en: Labels the poison the moment it lands

body.zh: 在不可信内容进入 Agent 的边界就贴上标签——抓取的网页、外部工具返回值——沿工具调用图逐跳传播，谁被染一目了然。同步与异步工具都支持。
body.en: Tags untrusted content at the boundary where it enters your agent — a fetched page, an external tool result — and propagates the label hop by hop through the tool-call graph. Sync and async tools both work.

chips: › 标记 web 抓取 / 工具结果

title.zh: 一份红色隔离清单：哪些动作要回滚
title.en: A red quarantine list: what to roll back

body.zh: 算出被投毒输入传递影响的全部副作用动作——文件写入、提交、外发——按距离排序给出隔离清单，而不是“全部推倒重来”。机器可读 JSON 可接进 CI 与事件响应。
body.en: Computes every side-effecting action the poisoned input transitively reached — file writes, commits, outbound sends — sorted by distance, instead of “nuke everything”. Machine-readable JSON drops straight into CI and incident response.

title.zh: 同时告诉你哪些已证清白
title.en: Also tells you what's proven clean

body.zh: 不只列出被污染的动作——还显式列出没有被任何不可信标签触及的动作，让你清楚什么不用碰。一半的价值在“这里你不用动”。
body.en: Beyond the tainted actions, it explicitly lists the calls no untrusted label ever reached — so you know what to leave alone. Half the value is “here's what you don't have to touch”.

title.zh: 按单一注入源圈定范围
title.en: Scope the blast radius to one injection

body.zh: 知道是哪一次抓取被投毒？用 --source 把爆炸半径缩到那一条注入，只回滚真正受影响的分支。离线 JSONL 复盘，无需数据库。
body.en: Know which fetch was poisoned? Use --source to narrow the blast radius to that one injection and roll back only the branch it actually touched. Offline JSONL replay, no database.

headline.zh: 下一次注入落地时，先看到爆炸半径，再决定怎么回滚。
headline.en: Next time an injection lands, see the blast radius first — then decide what to roll back.

sub.zh: 一个装饰器、一个 taint_source 调用，记录一次运行，跑一条 report。Apache 2.0 开源，无付费墙。
sub.en: One decorator, one taint_source call, record a run, run report. Apache 2.0 open source, no paywall.

tag.zh: 给自主 Agent 装上动态污点追踪 — 计算每一次 Prompt Injection 的爆炸半径。
tag.en: Dynamic taint tracking for autonomous agents — compute the blast radius of every Prompt Injection.
